component.name: Checkbox
component.description: A single on/off choice with a visible text label, wrapping a native checkbox input. Clicking the label toggles it. Works uncontrolled (defaultChecked), controlled (checked + onChange), and inside native forms (name/value submit when checked).

when: A settings or form field is a single independent yes/no choice (e.g. a notification preference)
Several independent options can each be on or off at once
The choice is applied on form submit rather than immediately as a filter — use Chip for pressed filters

patterns.name: preferences-stack
patterns.description: A vertical list of independent preferences inside a Card, sharing a name so checked values submit together.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Checkbox for mutually exclusive options
antiPatterns.reason: Checkboxes are independent; nothing prevents selecting several.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Select for a single choice from a fixed list.

antiPatterns.scenario: Rendering the label text yourself next to the Checkbox
antiPatterns.reason: The label prop is rendered inside the wrapping <label>, which makes the text clickable and gives the input its accessible name.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass the visible text through the label prop.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using pressed/onPressedChange or a custom value/onValueChange pair
antiPatterns.reason: Checkbox wraps a native input and keeps native names (ADR-026).

purpose.false: Unticked. Input background with a strong neutral border.
purpose.true: Ticked. Brand-filled box with an inverted check glyph. Native checked/defaultChecked + onChange (ADR-026); disabled applies in either state.

states.description: Input background with a strong neutral border.
Brand-filled box with an inverted check glyph. Set via checked or defaultChecked.
Muted border and label; checked boxes fill with the disabled background. Interaction blocked natively; works checked or unchecked.

ariaAttributes: checked state exposed natively by <input type="checkbox">
